page.overview:
What is Irma Crabbe?

Irma Black (née Crabbe) (fl. 1925-1938) was an English pure-blood witch and a member of the Crabbe family.

She was the wife of Pollux Black, the mother of Walburga Black, Alphard Black, and Cygnus Black (III) and the grandmother of Bellatrix Lestrange, Andromeda Tonks, Narcissa Malfoy, Sirius and Regulus Black.

Irma may also be a relative of Vincent Crabbe and his father, given that she shares their surname.

is a German short form of names beginning with the Old Germanic element ermen, meaning "whole" or "universal".
